title: Rafael and the Bakery
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Odile Joubert, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
